blockchain.title: Bitcoin Falls as Hot US Inflation Fuels Fears of Bigger Fed Rate Hike
blockchain.excerpt: Bitcoin fell below $74,000 after October inflation beat forecasts, increasing pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise rates again at its December meeting.

blockchain.title: Bitcoin nears 11-week low after ‘discouraging’ US CPI inflation beat
blockchain.excerpt: Bitcoin and US stocks initially fall after October inflation tops forecasts, with traders expecting a quarter-point Fed rate hike in December.

blockchain.title: Moody’s Taps Chainlink to Send Credit Ratings Across Multiple Blockchains
blockchain.excerpt: The testnet pilot used Chainlink’s CCIP to distribute Moody’s ratings simultaneously across permissioned and permissionless blockchains, while preserving the firm’s existing publication and governance processes.

blockchain.title: Bitcoin’s ‘best buying opportunity ever’ has arrived: Mark Moss
blockchain.excerpt: Bitcoin Opportunity Fund co-founder Mark Moss says that with banks and ETFs widening access to Bitcoin he expects a new record high in 2027.

blockchain.title: Morning Minute: Vitalik Recasts ETH as a Store of Value
blockchain.excerpt: It’s a big shift for Ethereum from the “ultrasound money” days. But can ETH compete as a store-of-value play?

defi.title: Goldman Sachs, Citi among banks said to commit $270 million to stablecoin venture
defi.excerpt: The venture, known as Project Faro, plans to issue a dollar-denominated stablecoin and is expected to be incorporated in the U.S.

defi.title: Crypto is now teamed up with U.S. government in two legal battles over perps
defi.excerpt: Twice now, crypto firms have found themselves on the side of the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission in holding that perpetual futures aren't swaps.

defi.title: Plume affiliate lands broker-dealer license to bring real U.S. assets onchain
defi.excerpt: Kimber Digital Securities secured SEC and Finra approvals, a regulatory milestone paving the way for the delivery of legally binding claims, dividends, and yield-bearing products directly to self-custodial wallets and stablecoin applications in the U.S.

defi.title: Solana's Jupiter Expands Beyond Trading With Token Baskets, Yield Vaults and New Portfolio
defi.excerpt: The trading platform, which says it has routed more than $1.3 trillion in trades, is launching four products ahead of Solana Breakpoint.

defi.title: Will stablecoins survive once the banks catch up?
defi.excerpt: As crypto firms and banks converge, it is fair to ask what lasting advantage stablecoins have, argues Alessandro Hatami, founder of Pacemakers and former COO of Digital Banking at Lloyds Banking Group.
